title: Cosmic Cathedral Mystic
description: A regal Black woman stands barefoot in an ancient gothic cathedral, wearing an ornate golden crown and flowing purple robes. Her right hand releases a cascading wave of glowing turquoise water that flows across the stone floor, while a vibrant cosmic nebula with stars, galaxies, and colorful light beams bursts through the arched stained-glass windows behind her.
prompt: A majestic Black woman with dark skin stands inside a vast gothic cathedral with towering stained glass windows. She wears an elaborate golden crown and ornate deep purple robes. She is barefoot on stone steps as a powerful wave of glowing turquoise water flows from her hands down the steps. Behind her a massive cosmic explosion of colorful nebulae, galaxies, stars and radiant beams of purple green and orange light pours through the cathedral. Ethereal fantasy style, cinematic lighting, intricate details.
